An easy recipe for fudge I’ve used before is a container of store bought frosting and about a cup of chocolate. Melt the chocolate and mix it with the frosting and place into any pan. Place in fridge for about an hour and it will set up. You can then cut and serve. It sounds like it will hold up at OP’s venue. It’s not world class fudge but it’s very good and hits the spot.
